description_en: Queries tasks created for a cloud phone instance. Many operations on cloud phones—such as creating, starting, or stopping them—are asynchronous. When you initiate an operation, the system returns a `Task ID` that you can use to track its progress and final result. You can call this API to retrieve a list of all tasks and their execution statuses
description_zh: 获取云手机实例当前任务列表。云手机很多（创建、开关机等）的操作都是异步进行，系统将产生一个任务ID供用户查询操作进度及结果。用户可通过调用该接口查询所有任务清单及执行情况
kebab_example: aliyun eds-aic describe-tasks --invoke-id B8ED2BA9-0C6A-5643-818F-B5D60A640000 --resource-ids acp-25nt4kk9whhok0000 --task-ids t-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --parent-task-id t-iaej5dkbnmivx0000 --task-type StartInstance --task-types StartInstance --task-status Processing --task-statuses Finished --level 1 --instance-id acp-2zecay9ponatdc4m0000 --instance-name defaultInstanceName --param param --max-results 10 --next-token FFbc8N4E1iOlcSxC+8boa0HHH2LKWbggYUinyrZWvtS1oTrMYCg1HuMLGuftj00000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeTasks

parameters.help_en: The ID of the command execution. You can set the value to the last returned request ID
parameters.help_zh: 命令执行ID，可以填写上一次操作返回的requestId
parameters.name: invoke_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the parent task
parameters.name: parent_task_id

parameters.help_en: The level of the task. A value of 1 specifies a batch task. A value of 2 specifies an instance-level task
parameters.help_zh: 任务级别，1表示批量任务；2表示实例级任务
parameters.name: level

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud phone instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the cloud phone instance
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的最大条目数。取值范围 1～100，默认值为 10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If the parameter is left empty, the data is queried from the first entry
parameters.help_zh: 用来表示当前开始读取的位置。置空表示从头开始
parameters.name: next_token
